cc:Work.dc:title: SN 12.2 Open Chain and Wheel Diagram v1
cc:Work.dc:creator: Yoso

svg.text: The sutta’s chain has a first term and a last; the commentary and the painting close it into a circle
old age and death · last term
Old age and death now sits next to ignorance,
Left: the twelve links in the order SN 12.2 gives them, from the first term to the last. Nothing leads back.
Right: the same links as a wheel. Gold marks where the commentary joins the end to the start.
Pāli and English follow SuttaCentral’s edition and Sujato’s translation.
